dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could try using Flaming Flower Stamens.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's a good idea. The Flaming Flower Stamens are really hot and should be able to dry them out in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To be on the safe side, you can also put them in a large glass bottle, so you don't have to worry about fire spreading.

dialogues.speaker: Mats
dialogues.text: Good idea. I'll send someone to get the needed materials!

dialogues.speaker: Mats
dialogues.text: You two are very clever, and I am in your debt!
